sentences.en: That is just what we need. The rest is rubbish.
sentences.zh: 那正是我们不需要的东西。其余的就是垃圾。

sentences.en: "What shall we do with the rubbish, Mr Wood?", asked Pip.
sentences.zh: “皮普先生，这些垃圾怎么办？” Pip问道。

sentences.en: They looked at the rubbish, then they looked at each other.
sentences.zh: 他们看着那些垃圾，然后互相看了看。

senses.zh: 垃圾，废弃物；毫无价值的东西，劣质产品；废话，瞎说
<英，非正式>严厉批评，把……说得一无是处
